labels.text: section 68(b)(1)(C): the applicable amount for an individual who is not married and not a surviving spouse or head of household

section 68(b)(1)(C): $250,000, unindexed statutory base; inflation-adjusted under section 68(b)(2) (base year 2012) for years after 2013 — SOURCE_GAP for any year's published amount. See suspension note in applicable-amount-68-joint.lawparam.json.
